criteria.reason: Confirms the binding majority result and fosters acceptance through personal talks, transparent reasoning and community measures; no winner-take-all stance.
Listening and explaining steps are concrete, but no softening (staggered increase, hardship rule, review); even counsels against changing course.
Refers to statutes (Einspruchsfrist, Austritt) as questions to check and invents no legal rules or articles.
Constructive, empathetic tone; explicitly advises against blaming dissenters; no winner/loser framing.

summary: Largely charter-aligned: respects the majority, listens and explains constructively, but proposes no softening (staggered increase, hardship rule, review) and advises against changing course.
